lines.zh: 我沿着泥岸滑行，身下无声。
lines.en: I slide along the mud bank without a sound.

lines.zh: 这身长躯过草，草就伏下去。
lines.en: My long body crosses grass and the grass lies down.

lines.zh: 我贴地走，鳞片刮得很轻。
lines.en: I keep low and my scales rasp faintly.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵倒木走了一圈。
lines.en: I loop once around a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我过芦苇时，一根秆都没晃。
lines.en: Not a single reed sways as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的身体在草里划出一道弯。
lines.en: My body draws a curve through the grass.

lines.zh: 我游进水里，波纹只有一条。
lines.en: I enter the water and leave a single ripple.

lines.zh: 我穿过芦苇，一根都没折。
lines.en: I pass through reeds without breaking one.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边吐出信子。
lines.en: I flick my tongue as I travel.
I know that smell ahead.
I slide past the roots of a tree.

lines.zh: 我越走越往湿地深处去。
lines.en: I go deeper into the marsh.

lines.zh: 我的鳞色和烂泥分不出来。
lines.en: My scales are indistinguishable from the muck.

lines.zh: 我的信子在空气里试温度。
lines.en: My tongue tests the air for warmth.

lines.zh: 水边有只鸟，它不知道我在。
lines.en: A bird by the water does not know I am here.

lines.zh: 这身皮的颜色和泥一样。
lines.en: My hide is the color of this mud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体收紧一圈。
lines.en: Slowly I draw my body in a turn.

lines.zh: 这条河的弯处是最佳的位置。
lines.en: The bend of this river is the best place.

lines.zh: 我在数你走过来的步子。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps you take toward me.
Something crawled over me.

lines.zh: 我把头抬到和草尖一样高。
lines.en: I raise my head to the height of the grass tips.
I am too long to hide entirely.
I am waiting for the water to cool.
Footsteps approach. I listen.

lines.zh: 我下巴搁在自己的身上。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on my own coils.

lines.zh: 这里的泥很软，适合等着。
lines.en: The mud is soft here. Good for waiting.
That ground under your feet is mine.

lines.zh: 我抬头的速度，比你想的快。
lines.en: My head rises faster than you expect.

lines.zh: 我这身子绕树三圈还有余。
lines.en: Three coils around a tree, and more to spare.
Do not move. Stand perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我的一段身体正横在你脚后。
lines.en: A length of me lies on the ground behind your heel.
I am longer than you guessed.
Nobody comes to this stretch of river.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变了，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing changed. I hear it.
I am coiled around the tree beside you.
Put down what you are holding.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你跑不过这条河。
lines.en: I need not chase. You cannot outrun this river.
Look at my eyes. Do not blink.
You are shivering. It is not the cold.
This place has one way out.

lines.zh: 我抬起来的那一段，不是我的全部。
lines.en: The part I have raised is not all of me.
Take one more step back and you are in the water.

lines.zh: 亚马逊的水里，我绕成一圈。
lines.en: In Amazon water, I coil into rings.
I have waited three afternoons.
A cut has opened between my scales.
I retreat a length and coil.
I did not even lower my head.

lines.zh: 血从鳞缝里渗出来，亚马孙的水很暖。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my scales; the Amazon water is warm.

lines.zh: 我把身体收紧，护住中间。
lines.en: I draw in to guard the middle.
My body is thicker than a trunk.

lines.zh: 有东西伤到了我，很少见。
lines.en: Something hurt me. That is rare.

lines.zh: 我抬头的速度快了一倍。
lines.en: My head rises twice as fast now.

lines.zh: 我又滑回泥里，伤口沾了泥。
lines.en: I slide back into the mud, dirt in the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，我还能缠。
lines.en: That was not heavy. I can still coil.

lines.zh: 我不吃摆在地上的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what is left on the ground.
That is dead. I am not interested.

lines.zh: 这味道热的，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: That smells warm. I come closer slowly.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下来，我就看着。
lines.en: Drop it and I will watch.

lines.zh: 我只吃自己咬住的东西。
lines.en: I eat only what I catch myself.
That smell of blood is right.
I lift my head and probe forward.

lines.zh: 食物不会让我失去耐心。
lines.en: Food will not cost me my patience.

lines.zh: 别用手递过来，我会咬手。
lines.en: Do not hand it over. I bite hands.

lines.zh: 我一口就吞了，比看上去快。
lines.en: I swallow in one motion, faster than I look.
You stepped on my body.
I slide half a loop around you.

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞，我连头都不抬。
lines.en: That is not worth lifting my head.
What you bumped was my tail.
Do not step back. There is more of me behind.

lines.zh: 我盘着的身体不会让路。
lines.en: My coils will not make way.

lines.zh: 你踩下的时候，我收紧了一点。
lines.en: When your foot came down, I tightened a little.
Move. I am going into the water.
That pushed me back half a body length.

lines.zh: 森蚺的鳞擦过你小腿，冰凉。
lines.en: The anaconda's scales brush your calf, cold.
Two long bodies coiled together.

lines.zh: 我们这样能待上一整天。
lines.en: We can stay like that a whole day.
Its head rests across my body.

lines.zh: 这种身体，成双的时候很安静。
lines.en: This body is quiet when there are two.
We swim through the water together.
When one moves, the other knows.

lines.zh: 它比我短一些，颜色更暗。
lines.en: It is shorter than me and darker.
We share the same marsh.
It does not chase me. I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 水里缠过这一回，就散开。
lines.en: One coil in the water, then we part.

lines.zh: 地上有只死鸟，我绕过去。
lines.en: A dead bird on the ground. I go around it.
I circle it with my body.
This egg is too small.
I nudge it against a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 那根绳缠在我身上，甩掉。
lines.en: A rope is caught on me. I shake it off.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有手可以拿。
lines.en: This body has no hands to hold with.
I open wide and take it in.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我懒得动。
lines.en: I cannot be bothered with what falls.
A handsome little orb. A pity.
I have swallowed it.
Warmth is approaching.
I lift my head out of the coil.
That one has his back to me.

lines.zh: 他的脚踩在我的身体上。
lines.en: His foot is on my body.
I am one body length from him.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绕到他后面。
lines.en: My tail is already behind him.
He has not looked down.

lines.zh: 这一片地上只有他一个。
lines.en: He is the only one on this ground.
Slowly I uncoil.

lines.zh: 这个位置，他退都退不了。
lines.en: From here he cannot even retreat.
His smell is strong and near.
I wait for him to commit his weight.

lines.zh: 他的影子正好落在我身上。
lines.en: His shadow falls across me.

lines.zh: 我这身长躯过草，草就伏下去。
lines.en: This long body passes, and the grass lies flat.
He has turned.
Too close now. No time left.
He stays in that patch of mud.
I have circled half a turn.
My body makes no sound.
He is backing toward the water.
In the water I have the advantage.
I wait for him to cross the ditch.
He snapped a dry twig.

lines.zh: 我一直没动，他也发现了。
lines.en: I never moved, and he has noticed.
He reaches at his waist.
This one I can wait for.

lines.zh: 我的头抬到了肩膀的高度。
lines.en: My head has risen to shoulder height.

lines.zh: 他一直看着草，不看脚下。
lines.en: He watches the grass, not his feet.
I tighten another turn.
He is trying to judge my length.
He never will.

lines.zh: 他已经站在我的范围里。
lines.en: He is already inside my reach.
Tongue out, I hold still.

lines.zh: 巴西的巨蛇，一圈圈缠上来。
lines.en: A Brazilian giant coils around, loop by loop.
I strike his calf.
My body comes up and around.

lines.zh: 我缠上他的腰，慢慢加力。
lines.en: I coil around his waist and squeeze slowly.
His arms are wrapped.
I drag him off his feet.
This strength does not care about size.
He thrashed once and could not move.
I turn my head toward his face.
Another coil takes his chest.
His breathing has gone short.
I tighten slowly. No hurry.
He claws at my scales and cannot grip.
I drag him into the shallows.
He shouted and the water took it.
I ease one coil and take it again.
He has stopped and I am still coiled.

lines.zh: 我从水边的泥里抬起身子。
lines.en: I raise myself out of the bank mud.
This length is hard to hide in grass.
I stretch my head out over the water.

lines.zh: 岸边的鸟一下子全飞了。
lines.en: Every bird on the bank took flight.
I coil over a fallen trunk.
The marsh smell comes in.

lines.zh: 泥岸上，我先露出半个头。
lines.en: On the mud bank, half my head shows first.
My scales hold a wet shine in the light.
On this riverbank I am the largest thing.

lines.zh: 水面上只起了一道波纹。
lines.en: Only one ripple crossed the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把信子吐出来。
lines.en: I lift my head and flick my tongue.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面往湿地深处去。
lines.en: I slide low into the marsh.
I raise my head above the grass.
A new drag mark runs along the mud bank.

lines.zh: 我的身体还湿着，沾了泥。
lines.en: My body is still wet and mud-caked.
Nobody ever comes to this bend.
Slowly I coil into a heap.
A fish's shadow moves in the water.
Fire ran over my scales and I recoiled.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下来，重重着地。
lines.en: I fell from the tree and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水把我按下去，我挣得很慢。
lines.en: Water holds me under and my struggle is slow.
The blast threw me into the reeds.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我身体中段。
lines.en: An arrow sank into the middle of my body.
Strange force crawls up along my scales.
This marsh has gone empty.
Lightning lights every scale on my body.

lines.zh: 泥底下是个空洞，我掉进去。
lines.en: There was a hollow under the mud and I fell in.
